extracted.name: Feta & clementine lunch bowl
extracted.description: Pair piquant feta with green lentils, sweet clementines and crunchy peppers in this colourful packed lunch. It’s low-calorie and rich in vitamin C and fibre
ingredient_lines: 1 red onion halved and thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Mix the onion with the lemon juice, lemon and clementine zest and garlic.

Tip the lentils into two bowls or lunchboxes and drizzle over the balsamic and 1 tbsp oil. Heat the remaining oil in a large non-stick wok, add the pepper and stir-fry for 3 mins. Tip in half the onion and cook until tender. Pile on top of the lentils, then mix the clementines, remaining onions, feta, mint and walnut pieces.
